401 Unauthorized error on web search due to invalid API credentials

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

do {
    let _req = try LiterLlm.searchRequestFromJson("{\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"test\"}")
    guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
    let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
    _ = try await _client.search(_req)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
